newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 seen rising to new peak on Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 seen rising to new peak on Dow rally.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 is poised to advance further on Friday, building on a record-setting close on Thursday, after the Dow staged another powerful rally overnight that drove the index to its fifth consecutive all-time high, dealers said.
The blue chip share index closed 32.6 points higher on Thursday at 4,657.4.
The Dow, up about 72 points when London markets closed, nearly doubled its gains by the close to finish 135.64 points higher.
